CREATE TABLE activities (source TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, observed_date TEXT NOT NULL, record_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id))
CREATE TABLE wellness (source TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, observed_date TEXT NOT NULL, record_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source,source_id))
CREATE INDEX activity_dates ON activities(observed_date)
CREATE INDEX wellness_dates ON wellness(observed_date)
CREATE TABLE events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, sport TEXT NOT NULL, goal TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT)

CREATE TABLE sync_status (category TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_attempt_utc TEXT, last_success_utc TEXT, read_status TEXT NOT NULL, rejected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, incomplete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE review_schedule (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), state_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE review_import_changes (revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, category TEXT NOT NULL, observed_date TEXT NOT NULL, received_utc TEXT NOT NULL, identity_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, sport TEXT, sleep_changed INTEGER NOT NULL, sleep_available INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX review_import_identity ON review_import_changes(category,identity_sha256,revision)

CREATE TABLE athlete_context (context_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), category TEXT NOT NULL, author_attribution TEXT NOT NULL, entered_by TEXT NOT NULL, observed_on TEXT NOT NULL, applicable_from TEXT, applicable_until TEXT, sport TEXT, activity_id TEXT, review_id TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL, retired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(retired IN (0,1)), source_category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user_report' CHECK(source_category IN ('user_report','clinician_guidance','coach_guidance','review_feedback')), restriction_kind TEXT, restriction_value TEXT, restriction_unit TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(context_id,revision), CHECK(applicable_until IS NULL OR applicable_from IS NULL OR applicable_until >= applicable_from))

CREATE TABLE context_intakes (intake_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), content TEXT NOT NULL, source_category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_category IN ('user_report','clinician_guidance','coach_guidance')), author_attribution TEXT NOT NULL, entered_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entered_by='authenticated_user'), observed_on TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_utc TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(intake_id,revision))

CREATE TABLE context_intake_links (context_id TEXT NOT NULL, context_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, intake_id TEXT NOT NULL, intake_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(context_id,context_revision), FOREIGN KEY(context_id,context_revision) REFERENCES athlete_context(context_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(intake_id,intake_revision) REFERENCES context_intakes(intake_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX context_intake_lookup ON context_intake_links(intake_id,intake_revision)

CREATE TABLE context_lifecycle (context_id TEXT NOT NULL, context_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, resolution TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution IN ('unresolved','resolved')), review_due_on TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(context_id,context_revision), FOREIGN KEY(context_id,context_revision) REFERENCES athlete_context(context_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE commitment_revisions (commitment_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), intake_id TEXT NOT NULL, intake_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, context_id TEXT, context_revision INTEGER, event_id TEXT, definition_json TEXT NOT NULL, entered_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entered_by='authenticated_user'), confirmed_utc TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(commitment_id,revision), CHECK((context_id IS NULL)=(context_revision IS NULL)), FOREIGN KEY(intake_id,intake_revision) REFERENCES context_intakes(intake_id,revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(context_id,context_revision) REFERENCES athlete_context(context_id,revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT)
CREATE INDEX commitment_intake_lookup ON commitment_revisions(intake_id,intake_revision)
CREATE INDEX commitment_context_lookup ON commitment_revisions(context_id,context_revision)
CREATE TRIGGER commitment_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON commitment_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'commitment revisions are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE context_confirmation_receipts (confirmation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, intake_id TEXT NOT NULL, intake_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, refs_json TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(intake_id,intake_revision) REFERENCES context_intakes(intake_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE context_deletion_fences (context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_purged_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(last_purged_revision > 0))

CREATE TABLE plan_revisions (plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), previous_revision INTEGER, definition_json TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_utc TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(plan_id,revision), CHECK((revision=1 AND previous_revision IS NULL) OR (revision>1 AND previous_revision=revision-1)))
CREATE TRIGGER plan_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'plan revisions are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE plan_selection (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0), selected_plan_id TEXT, selected_revision INTEGER, CHECK((selected_plan_id IS NULL)=(selected_revision IS NULL)), FOREIGN KEY(selected_plan_id,selected_revision) REFERENCES plan_revisions(plan_id,revision))
CREATE TABLE plan_effort_scales (scale_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, definition_json TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX athlete_context_observed ON athlete_context(observed_on)
CREATE INDEX athlete_context_applicability ON athlete_context(applicable_from,applicable_until,sport,activity_id)

CREATE TABLE connected_review_snapshots (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, packet_json TEXT NOT NULL, packet_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL, refs_json TEXT NOT NULL, coverage_from TEXT NOT NULL, coverage_until TEXT NOT NULL, sport TEXT, provider TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, contract_version TEXT NOT NULL, created_utc TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(request_id,generation))

CREATE TABLE connected_review_snapshot_state (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES connected_review_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state TEXT NOT NULL, stale_reason TEXT, published_output TEXT)
CREATE TABLE connected_review_requests (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, active_generation INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE connected_review_context_refs (snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connected_review_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, context_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,context_id,revision))
CREATE INDEX connected_review_context_lookup ON connected_review_context_refs(context_id)
CREATE TRIGGER connected_review_snapshot_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON connected_review_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'connected review snapshots are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE scoped_activity_identities (identity_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source,source_id), FOREIGN KEY(source,source_id) REFERENCES activities(source,source_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE scoped_review_configuration (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), timezone_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(timezone_confirmed IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE scoped_evidence_snapshots (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, binding_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, packet_sha256 TEXT, packet_json TEXT, manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_utc TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK((packet_sha256 IS NULL)=(packet_json IS NULL)))
CREATE TRIGGER scoped_evidence_snapshot_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON scoped_evidence_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scoped evidence snapshots are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE plan_amendment_proposals (proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, submission_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, projection_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, projection_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_utc TEXT NOT NULL, expires_utc TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX plan_amendment_proposal_snapshot_lookup ON plan_amendment_proposals(source_snapshot_id)
CREATE TRIGGER plan_amendment_proposal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_amendment_proposals BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'plan amendment proposals are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE plan_amendment_proposal_state (proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES plan_amendment_proposals(proposal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','no_change','needs_confirmation','rejected','applied')), reason TEXT CHECK(reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('user_rejected','invalid_whole_draft','policy_validation')), rejected_utc TEXT)

CREATE TABLE plan_amendment_approval_audit (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, proposal_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, applied_plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, applied_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, applied_utc TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(applied_plan_id,applied_revision) REFERENCES plan_revisions(plan_id,revision))
CREATE TRIGGER plan_amendment_approval_audit_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_amendment_approval_audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'plan amendment approval audit is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE plan_amendment_approval_bindings (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_amendment_approval_audit(operation_id), proposal_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_amendment_proposals(proposal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER plan_amendment_approval_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON plan_amendment_approval_bindings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'plan amendment approval binding is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE scoped_evidence_dependencies (snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('context','intake','commitment','plan','adaptation_result')), identity TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0), PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,kind,identity,revision))
CREATE INDEX scoped_evidence_dependency_lookup ON scoped_evidence_dependencies(kind,identity)

CREATE TABLE scoped_evidence_records (snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(category IN ('activities','wellness')), source TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER, record_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, roles_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,category,source,source_id))

CREATE TABLE scoped_execution_bindings (execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0), profile TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(profile IN ('scoped-descriptive-v1','context-intake-suggestion-v1','plan-amendment-selection-v1')), source_snapshot_id TEXT REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, intake_id TEXT, intake_revision INTEGER, binding_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_utc TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(request_id,generation), CHECK((source_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL)!=(intake_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((intake_id IS NULL)=(intake_revision IS NULL)), CHECK((profile='context-intake-suggestion-v1')=(intake_id IS NOT NULL)), FOREIGN KEY(intake_id,intake_revision) REFERENCES context_intakes(intake_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX scoped_execution_snapshot_lookup ON scoped_execution_bindings(source_snapshot_id)
CREATE INDEX scoped_execution_intake_lookup ON scoped_execution_bindings(intake_id,intake_revision)
CREATE TRIGGER scoped_execution_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON scoped_execution_bindings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scoped execution bindings are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE scoped_execution_state (execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES scoped_execution_bindings(execution_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('IN_FLIGHT','RUNNING','PUBLISHED','FAILED','STALE','INTERRUPTED')), stale_reason TEXT, validated_output_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE scoped_queue_metadata (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(source_revision)='integer' AND source_revision>=0), plan_reason_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(plan_reason_revision)='integer' AND plan_reason_revision>=0))
CREATE TABLE scoped_queue_snapshot_ownership (snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE personal_review_runtime_owner (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), epoch TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation>=0))

CREATE TABLE personal_review_runtime_claims (claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, domain_id TEXT NOT NULL, execution_id TEXT NOT NULL, claim_json TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('RESERVED','START_INTENT','EXECUTING','STOPPING','STOP_CONFIRMED','UNKNOWN')), publication_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(publication_allowed IN (0,1)), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 2))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX personal_review_runtime_occupancy ON personal_review_runtime_claims(domain_id) WHERE phase<>'STOP_CONFIRMED'
CREATE TABLE scoped_queue_preview_ownership (execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES scoped_execution_bindings(execution_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE plan_reconciliation_confirmations (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, confirmation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, confirmation_json TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(plan_id,plan_revision) REFERENCES plan_revisions(plan_id,revision))
CREATE INDEX plan_reconciliation_plan_lookup ON plan_reconciliation_confirmations(plan_id,sequence)

CREATE TABLE activity_effort_lineages (report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, activity_id TEXT NOT NULL, scale_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_effort_scales(scale_id), detached INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(detached IN (0,1)), detachment_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(detachment_generation>=0), UNIQUE(activity_id,scale_id))

CREATE TABLE activity_effort_reports (report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_effort_lineages(report_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), report_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(report_id,revision))

CREATE TABLE activity_effort_operations (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, report_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(report_id,revision) REFERENCES activity_effort_reports(report_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE personal_signal_rule_revisions (rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), rule_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(rule_id,revision))
CREATE TRIGGER personal_signal_rule_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON personal_signal_rule_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'personal signal rule revisions are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE personal_signal_rule_operations (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(rule_id,revision) REFERENCES personal_signal_rule_revisions(rule_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE personal_signal_rule_state (rule_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation>0), state_json TEXT NOT NULL, replay_json TEXT, high_water_json TEXT)
CREATE TABLE extra_workload_rule_revisions (rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), rule_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(rule_id,revision))
CREATE TRIGGER extra_workload_rule_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON extra_workload_rule_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'extra workload rule revisions are immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE extra_workload_rule_operations (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(rule_id,revision) REFERENCES extra_workload_rule_revisions(rule_id,revision) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE TABLE adaptation_reason_heads (reason_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, head_json TEXT NOT NULL, support_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE adaptation_admissions (reason_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adaptation_reason_heads(reason_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, episode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(episode)='integer' AND episode>0), admission_json TEXT NOT NULL, fulfilled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(fulfilled IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(reason_id,episode))

CREATE TABLE adaptation_results (work_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES scoped_evidence_snapshots(snapshot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, work_json TEXT NOT NULL, valid_until_utc TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE signal_evidence_mutations (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, source TEXT NOT NULL, identity_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, old_date TEXT, new_date TEXT NOT NULL, fields_json TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE signal_evidence_epoch (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), removal_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(removal_generation)='integer' AND removal_generation>=0))

CREATE TABLE constraint_observation_metadata (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), mutation_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(mutation_sequence)='integer' AND mutation_sequence>=0), deletion_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(deletion_generation)='integer' AND deletion_generation>=0), retained_from_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(retained_from_sequence)='integer' AND retained_from_sequence>=1), available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(available)='integer' AND available IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE constraint_observation_inventory (kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('context','intake','commitment')), identity TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), present INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(present IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(kind,identity))
CREATE TABLE constraint_observation_mutations (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0), refs_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE constraint_family_enrollments (family_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family_json TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, baseline_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(baseline_sequence)='integer' AND baseline_sequence>=0), baseline_deletion_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(baseline_deletion_generation)='integer' AND baseline_deletion_generation>=0), cursor_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(cursor_sequence)='integer' AND cursor_sequence>=baseline_sequence), cursor_deletion_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(cursor_deletion_generation)='integer' AND cursor_deletion_generation>=baseline_deletion_generation), available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(available)='integer' AND available IN (0,1)), baseline_proof_json TEXT, event_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(event_count)='integer' AND event_count BETWEEN 0 AND 50000), CHECK(available=0 OR baseline_proof_json IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE constraint_material_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES constraint_family_enrollments(family_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT, mutation_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(mutation_sequence)='integer' AND mutation_sequence>0), subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind IN ('context','commitment')), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL, proof_json TEXT)
CREATE INDEX constraint_material_events_family ON constraint_material_events(family_key,mutation_sequence)
